chapter.verse: Mihingte' kam leh vanmite' kam ka pau thei zongin itna ka neih keileh daktal kitum bang, daltuah kisat bang ka hi lel ding hi.
Kamsanna nei-in thuthuk khempeuh thei-in thutheihna khempeuh ka nei zongin, upna nei-in mualte ka kinsak thei zongin, itna ka neih keileh bangmahlo ka hi lel hi.
Ka neih khempeuh piakhia-in mei-a hal dingin ka pumpi ka paai zongin itna ka neih keileh bangmah ka phattuampih kei hi.
Itna pen lungduai-in migi hi; itna in haza lo hi; itna pen kisial lo-in kiphasak lo a,
zong ngongpau lo, ama' ading bek ci lo, heh pakpak lo, mawhna zong ciamteh lo hi.
Thumaanlo thu nuamsa lo a, thumaan thutak lungdampih hi.
Itna in na khempeuh sangsiamin na khempeuh umin na khempeuh lamenin na khempeuh thuakzo hi.
Itna in bei hun nei lo hi. Kamsannate bei-in kamtuam paunate khawlin thutheihna zong bei ding hi.
A hang pen a langbai bekin i thei a, a langbai bekin kam i sang hi.
Ahi zongin kicinna hong tun ciangin langbaina bei ding hi.
Naupang ka hih lai-in naupang bangin pau-in naupang bangin ka ngaihsun a, naupang bangin ka khinkhai hi. Ka gol ciangin naupangvai teng ka nusia hi.

A hang pen tu-in dalpek sungah a mual milmial bekin i mu a, ahi zongin tua hun ciangin maitang kituahin i mu ding hi. Tu laitak a langsamin ka thei a, tua hun ciangin kei a kicingin hong kitheih mah bangin kei zong a kicingin ka thei ding hi.
Tua hi a, tu-in upna, lametna, leh itna, hih nam thum om a, tuate lakah itna a lianpen ahi hi.
